briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 multi-agent release intensifies AGI race with Meta and xAI

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases as compute scaling continues. US-China tensions shape export controls and talent flows. Safety concerns grow with production deployments.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4 with native multi-agent orchestration. Anthropic releases Claude 4 Opus while xAI deploys Grok-5 on expanded Memphis cluster. DeepSeek-V4 closes gap on coding benchmarks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and IoT environments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reaches 500k units monthly. Google and Microsoft announce joint 10GW data center builds in Texas. TSMC secures new 2nm capacity for AI accelerators.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will regulatory fragmentation slow US frontier progress relative to China by 2028?
